sources.title: Adobe: Speed
sources.evidence: AE Easy Ease In/Out uses incoming/outgoing keyframe sides; path sample spacing and speed graph describe change over time.

sources.title: Blender: F-Curve Properties
sources.evidence: Segment Ease In accelerates, Ease Out decelerates; back, bounce and elastic are different curve families. Locale-specific page used; no installed-version claim.

sources.title: Adobe: 12 Principles of Animation
sources.evidence: Anticipation, follow-through, overlap and squash/stretch provide separate temporal mechanisms; staging concerns attention.

sources.title: Adobe: Shape attributes and path operations
sources.evidence: Fill/stroke and nondestructive path operations; Trim Paths controls path coverage, Repeater copies transforms.

sources.title: Adobe: Offset Paths
sources.evidence: Contour offsets and join types; offset copies preserve a relationship to the original outline.

sources.title: Adobe: Formatting characters
sources.evidence: Kerning adjusts pairs, tracking a selected range, leading line spacing; baseline and font metrics remain separate.

sources.title: Adobe: Animating text
sources.evidence: Text animators and selectors apply properties to subsets of characters; text paths provide a spatial arrangement.

sources.title: Adobe: Track Mattes
sources.evidence: Alpha and luma use different input channels; normal/inverted modes use opposite coverage. Mode table used: normal 100% alpha/luma is opaque; introductory prose contains a conflicting transparency statement.

sources.title: Adobe: Alpha channels, masks and mattes
sources.evidence: Masks modify visibility; feather changes boundary transition. A flattened opaque image does not disclose its source matte.

sources.title: Adobe: Blending modes
sources.evidence: Multiply, Screen, Add, Overlay and Difference have distinct color operations; stencil/silhouette affect underlying layer coverage.

sources.title: Adobe: 3D camera tracking
sources.evidence: Video analysis extracts camera motion and scene data; placing graphics on a solved plane is a separate use of that analysis.

sources.title: Adobe: Expression basics
sources.evidence: Expressions calculate property values at a time and link properties; their use is not inferable from a rendered still.

sources.title: Adobe: Time effects
sources.evidence: Echo combines distinct times, Posterize Time samples temporal states, Pixel Motion Blur uses motion vectors.

sources.title: Adobe: Composition basics
sources.evidence: Shutter angle and frame rate jointly determine effective exposure; phase shifts exposure position.

sources.title: Apple: Behaviors versus keyframes
sources.evidence: Behaviors generate parameter values over a duration; keyframes store selected values at selected times.

sources.title: Apple: Intro to replicators
sources.evidence: Source cells repeat in authored arrangements such as lines, circles and spirals.

sources.title: Apple: Replicators versus particles
sources.evidence: Particle birth, motion and death differ from a replicator's static copies, even when both are later animated.

sources.title: Maxon: MoGraph Overview SDK
sources.evidence: Cloners, effectors and fields have different roles; fields replace the prior falloff system.

sources.title: Maxon: MoGraph Basics
sources.evidence: Cloners distribute copies on lines, grids and surfaces; shader, sound, spline and delay effectors differ.

sources.title: Blender: Geometry Nodes introduction
sources.evidence: Geometry operations process meshes, curves, points, volumes and instances in a modifier flow.

sources.title: Blender: Simple Deform
sources.evidence: Twist, bend, taper and stretch use declared local axes and origins.

sources.title: Blender: Displacement Node
sources.evidence: True displacement changes geometry; a displacement input may also be evaluated as bump depending on settings.

sources.title: Blender: Principled BSDF
sources.evidence: Roughness, metallic, IOR, transmission, alpha and normals are independent material controls.

sources.title: Blender: Cameras
sources.evidence: Perspective and orthographic differ in projected size and convergence; focal length controls field of view.

sources.title: Blender: Cameras and depth of field
sources.evidence: Focus distance, depth of field and bokeh are optical appearance concepts. Older manual used for stable definitions only.

sources.title: Blender: Glare Node
sources.evidence: Highlight thresholds and glare spread produce source-related bloom; glow itself does not prove a physical emitter.

sources.title: Blender: Fluid Flow
sources.evidence: Flow objects add/remove fluid in a domain; smoke and liquid are distinct flow types.

sources.title: Blender: Cloth examples
sources.evidence: Pins and collision objects provide attachment and contact constraints. Staging page; verify again before adopting production parameters.

sources.title: Blender: Render passes
sources.evidence: Depth, normal and Cryptomatte are data passes and isolation outputs, not beauty-image styles.

sources.title: Academy: ACES System
sources.evidence: ACES includes scene-referred encoding and output transforms; it is not a single visual look.

sources.title: Academy: ACES Output Transforms
sources.evidence: Rendering and display encoding are distinct transform stages.

sources.title: Apple: ProRes White Paper
sources.evidence: ProRes 4444 and 4444 XQ support optional alpha; codec family names alone do not establish a specific alpha export.

sources.title: OpenEXR: Technical Introduction
sources.evidence: HDR and multichannel image storage are delivery capabilities; inspect actual channels and metadata.

sources.title: Plugin Play: Datamosh
sources.evidence: Datamoshing manipulates video compression and motion-vector relationships; a still can show an inspired smear but not establish the procedure.

sources.title: Adobe: Halftone screens
sources.evidence: Dot size and screen arrangement produce tonal variation; halftone structure differs from irregular grain.

sources.title: Blender: Shader to RGB
sources.evidence: Shader output followed by a color ramp can produce toon rendering; node pipeline is not provable from a beauty image.

sources.title: Apple Motion: Kaleidoscope filter
sources.evidence: Segment angle, center and offset angle control repeated triangular image sectors; filter is not automatically animated.

sources.title: Blender: Force Fields Introduction
sources.evidence: Fields affect simulation entities; influence, noise and falloff are parameters, not observable force labels in a still.

sources.title: OpenColorIO: Overview
sources.evidence: OCIO manages color configurations and is compatible with ACES; it is not a single visual look.

sources.title: Adobe: Supported file formats
sources.evidence: Codec and container are distinct; supported formats and channel depths vary by implementation.

sources.title: Apple Motion: Camera behaviors
sources.evidence: Dolly, focus, framing, sweep and zoom behaviors control different camera properties.

sources.title: Autodesk: Isometric View
sources.evidence: Isometric is a special axonometric view with equal foreshortening. Older primary documentation used for stable geometry, not current application behavior.

sources.title: Getty AAT: collage technique
sources.evidence: Collage attaches paper, fabric, photographs or other materials to a supporting surface; proposed pixel gates do not establish actual making process.

sources.title: Getty: Cut! Paper Play in Contemporary Photography
sources.evidence: Exhibition discusses cutting, layering, folding and assembling photographic paper as visible material relationships.

sources.title: Adobe: Rendering and exporting basics
sources.evidence: Rendering settings, compression and codecs govern delivery; not all codecs support alpha, timing review needs movies.

sources.title: W3C SVG 2: Painting
sources.evidence: Formal definitions for fills, strokes, line caps, line joins and dash patterns.

sources.title: W3C SVG 2: Paths
sources.evidence: Open and closed subpaths, curve segments and path direction are geometry, independent of animation timing.

sources.title: W3C SVG 2: Text
sources.evidence: Text spans, baselines, spacing and text on paths require explicit text content and layout.

sources.title: W3C SVG 2: Basic Shapes
sources.evidence: Basic shape geometry and corner radii are explicit shape parameters.

sources.title: Vega-Lite: Encoding
sources.evidence: Visual channels bind fields to position, marks, color and guides; factual data values require declared input data.

sources.title: Blender: Volume Scatter
sources.evidence: Light scatters in a volume; density and anisotropy are source parameters, not directly recoverable from a beauty image.

profiles.definition_ko: 끝점이 남는 선과 연결된 폐곡선을 구분하고, 선을 따라 놓인 스트로크와 내부 영역을 채우는 필을 별도 속성으로 기록한다.

components_all_of.observable_ko: 열린 선의 두 끝점 또는 닫힌 윤곽의 연결이 읽힌다
스트로크의 중심 경로와 내부 채움 영역이 구별된다
요청한 직선·곡선·모서리 구조가 유지되고 패스의 연결이 끊기지 않는다

required_relations_ko: stroke follows path; fill occupies declared interior
confusion_boundaries_ko: 열린 패스도 채움 규칙에 따라 내부가 채워질 수 있으므로 fill을 closure 증거로 쓰지 않는다
기계 부품의 실제 윤곽이나 인체 윤곽을 벡터 패스로 바꾸지 않는다
profiles.source_role: 용어·기술 경계의 근거. 아래 구성요소·소유권·게이트 조합은 이 리서치의 데이터 설계 제안이다.
profiles.activation_policy: 범용 별칭은 advisory. 비부정 요청·사용자 정의·적용 대상·열린 차원을 확인한 뒤 구체적인 관계만 채택한다.
profiles.static_claim_limit: 정지 결과는 선언된 형태만 검증한다. 시간 순서·제작 도구·물리 파라미터·원본 레이어·파일 채널은 추론하지 않는다.
profiles.pixel_policy: 각 필수 구성요소와 소유권 관계를 별도로 판정한다. partial_is_fail; 가림·해상도 부족·증거 매체 부족은 UNOBSERVABLE이다.
profiles.required_variant_resolution: 요청한 subtype·속성·적용 대상을 선택한 뒤 단일 의미의 authored profile로 분리한다. family 안의 대안들을 동시에 의무화하지 않는다.

profiles.definition_ko: 개방 선 끝의 절단·반원·정사각 연장 형태를 끝점에서 확인한다. 같은 선폭이라도 끝의 범위는 다르다.

components_all_of.observable_ko: 중심선의 끝 위치와 선폭이 식별된다
butt·round·square 중 요청한 끝 형태가 양 끝에 존재한다
다른 선이나 장면 물체의 끝에 효과가 전파되지 않는다

required_relations_ko: cap terminates declared stroke at its endpoint
confusion_boundaries_ko: round cap을 round join으로 대체하지 않는다
글자 전체를 둥근 글꼴로 바꾸는 것은 선 끝 캡의 증거가 아니다

profiles.definition_ko: 두 선분의 연결 부위가 날카로운 연장, 둥근 연결, 잘린 모서리 중 어떤 형태인지 분리한다.

components_all_of.observable_ko: 두 선분이 공유하는 연결점과 각도가 보인다
요청된 miter·round·bevel 윤곽이 연결 부위에 나타난다
각도가 작은 부위에서도 요청한 연결 규칙 또는 명시한 miter limit 처리와 맞는다

required_relations_ko: join connects adjacent stroke segments
confusion_boundaries_ko: 선 전체의 흐림을 round join으로 인정하지 않는다
선 끝의 cap과 연결점의 join은 서로 독립이다

profiles.definition_ko: 선의 경로를 따라 반복되는 표시 길이와 빈 간격을 한 패턴으로 기술한다.

대시 길이·빈 간격의 요청 패턴이 유지된다
